source: Hand-curated vocabulary across Genki I lessons 1–12 (Banno et al.).
notes: Vocabulary from Genki I, organized by lesson (L1–L12). Numbers 1–10, days of the week, and the most basic greetings (こんにちは, ありがとう) are intentionally skipped — they live in the JLPT N4/N5 Core deck. The focus is the content vocab and useful function words from each chapter: question words and demonstratives (L2), daily-activity verbs and time markers (L3), location words and existence verbs (L4), i/na-adjectives (L5), te-form requests and movement verbs (L6), family terms and physical description (L7), majors and intentions (L8), food (L9), comparisons and weather/seasons (L10), wants and activities (L11), and complaints and body/health (L12).
